question: Should OpenClaw adopt `append?: boolean` as a built-in write-tool capability and `SandboxFsBridge.appendFile` as an optional public Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The implementation appears sound, but both surfaces become durable user, model, and plugin contracts whose permanent inclusion cannot be inferred from tests or proof alone.

options.title: Sponsor and reopen
options.body: Adopt the capability-gated API, retain explicit unsupported-backend omission and no-auto-retry semantics, and reopen this proven branch for owner review and landing.

options.title: Keep overwrite-only core
options.body: Decline the new core and Plugin SDK surface and pursue the canonical data-loss issue through a different protection or coordination design.

options.title: Narrow the capability
options.body: Limit native append to an internal owner-specific path and remove the general model-facing or public bridge contract before reconsideration.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and reopen
recommendation.body: Adopt the capability-gated API, retain explicit unsupported-backend omission and no-auto-retry semantics, and reopen this proven branch for owner review and landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans product behavior, public tool semantics, Plugin SDK compatibility, and release integration rather than a narrow mechanical repair.
